title: DataAssessmentConfigItem - Tooling API
description: Represents a saved configuration for a specific vendor’s package for data assessment. This object is available in API version 40.0 and later.

DataAssessmentConfigField.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
